title: About Me
content: Full-stack Software Engineer with professional production experience across frontend, backend, and CMS-integrated web platforms. Builds with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL — designing REST APIs, resolving accessibility and performance issues, and shipping features end-to-end. Increasingly focused on business automation and AI-agent systems, using tools like Mastra and n8n to connect APIs and streamline operational workflows.
